subject: English
passage: Renowned chef Auguste Escoffier (1846–1935) created his famous clarified consommé using a filtering technique called the raft method. This technique involves adding a mixture of egg whites and ground meat to the cloudy broth. ______ the broth becomes crystal clear and perfectly transparent.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. "As a result" logically signals that the information in this sentence—the broth becoming clear—is a result of the filtering technique discussed in the previous sentence.
